A little about us

Hospitality begins with a good meal.

Naana's Catering and Hospitality Company Limited is a Ghanaian food and hospitality business based in Tema. We bring people together through delicious meals, refreshments and catering services.

We believe good food should be prepared with care and served with genuine hospitality. Whether you're looking for a satisfying meal, a refreshing drink or catering for an occasion, we're happy to hear from you.
